> This notebook enumerates all layout candidates that are suitable for a book
> set in 11-point *Centaur*. Each candidate defines:
>
> - a whole-pica text width that yields 44--66 characters per line
> - a whole-line text height that produces a harmoniously proportioned text
>   block
> - page dimensions and margins that produce harmonious proportions for all
>   rectangles of positive & negative space on the one- and two-page spread
>
> Results are saved as a package dataset, see `help(layout_candidates)`.



Since this book will be typeset in metal using 11-point type on a 12-point body,
the textblock height must be a multiple of 12 points[^1]. The textblock width
should run 44--66 characters per line, and physical limitations of the composing
stick require the width to be a multiple of whole picas. If we require the
textblock to have "harmonious" proportions, then there are only 30 possible
textblocks to consider.

[^1]: Initial proofs ruled out a 13-point baseline as too loose for such
    relatively narrow columns of text.


``` r
textblock_candidates <- expand_grid(

  # consider full-pica text widths that yield 44-66 characters per line
  text_width = list(min_width = 44, max_width = 66) |>
    map(estimate_line_length, font = "Centaur MT Pro", fontsize = "11pt") |>
    map(~ 72.27 * .["mean"]) |>
    with(list(
      from = floor(min_width / 12) * 12,
      to = ceiling(max_width / 12) * 12,
      by = 12
    )) |>
    do.call(what = seq),

  # consider harmonious textblock ratios
  text_ratio = as.numeric(ratios[ratios > 1 & ratios <= 2])
) |>

  # limit to textblocks with a 12-point baseline skip
  mutate(text_height = text_width * text_ratio) |>
  filter((text_height %% 12) == 0) |> # limit to 12-point baseline skip

  # tidy up
  transmute(
    text_width = text_width / 72.27,
    text_height = text_height / 72.27,
    text_width_picas = 72.27 * text_width / 12,
    text_height_lines = 72.27 * text_height / 12,
    text_ratio = name_ratios(text_ratio)
  )
```

<img src="figure/textblock_candidates_plot-1.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

For each textblock candidate, consider a range of page sizes that pad the
textblock with 4--12 picas of horizontal space and 5--12 lines of vertical space
for margins. This grid search discretizes page dimensions to the nearest 0.001
inch, then filters down to candidates with harmonious one-page and two-page
dimensions plus wider candidates within 0.01° of the ideal ratio. This
redundancy will be eliminated later.


``` r
page_candidates <- textblock_candidates |>
  mutate(
    page_candidates = map2(text_width, text_height, function(w, h) {
      expand_grid(

        # consider page widths with 4-12 picas added for horizontal margins
        page_width = seq(
          round_any(w + 4 * 12 / 72.27, 0.001, floor),
          round_any(w + 12 * 12 / 72.27, 0.001, ceiling),
          by = 0.001
        ),

        # consider page heights with 5-12 lines added for vertical margins
        page_height = seq(
          round_any(h + 5 * 12 / 72.27, 0.001, floor),
          round_any(h + 12 * 12 / 72.27, 0.001, ceiling),
          by = 0.001
        )
      ) |>
        mutate(
          page_ratio = as.numeric(round_ratios(
            w = page_width,
            h = page_height,
            target = "wider"
          ))
        ) |>
        drop_na() |>
        mutate(
          page_2up_ratio = as.numeric(round_ratios(
            w = 2 * page_width,
            h = page_height,
            target = "wider"
          ))
        ) |>
        drop_na()
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(page_candidates)
```

Both the bottom:top and outer:inner margin ratios should lock into harmonious
proportions greater than one but no more than two, yielding
144 possible margin ratio pairs. For each page
candidate, consider each of these textblock placements and filter down to those
that serendipitously produce harmonious ratios for all resulting rectangles of
positive & negative space on the two-page spread. Again, a tolerance of ±0.01°
results in some redundancy that will be eliminated in the next step.


``` r
margin_candidates <- expand_grid(
  bt_ratio = as.numeric(ratios[ratios > 1 & ratios <= 2]),
  oi_ratio = as.numeric(ratios[ratios > 1 & ratios <= 2])
) |>
  mutate(
    margins = map2(bt_ratio, oi_ratio, function(bt, oi) {
      page_candidates |>
        mutate(
          b_mar = (page_height - text_height) * (bt / (1 + bt)),
          t_mar = (page_height - text_height) * (1 / (1 + bt)),
          o_mar = (page_width - text_width) * (oi / (1 + oi)),
          i_mar = (page_width - text_width) * (1 / (1 + oi)),
          text_2up_ratio = round_ratios(
            w = 2 * (text_width + i_mar),
            h = text_height
          )
        ) |>
        drop_na() |>
        mutate(
          ot_ratio = round_ratios(w = o_mar, h = t_mar),
          ob_ratio = round_ratios(w = o_mar, h = b_mar),
          ti_ratio = round_ratios(w = i_mar, h = t_mar),
          bi_ratio = round_ratios(w = i_mar, h = b_mar),
          oii_ratio = round_ratios(o_mar, 2 * i_mar),
          tii_ratio = round_ratios(t_mar, 2 * i_mar),
          bii_ratio = round_ratios(b_mar, 2 * i_mar)
        ) |>
        drop_na() |>
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.numeric))
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(margins) |>
  select(
    starts_with("page"),
    starts_with("text"),
    ends_with("mar"),
    everything()
  ) |>
  select(
    -ends_with("ratio"),
    everything()
  )
```

For each candidate, calculate the error for each rectangle of positive &
negative space on the two-page spread, then sum errors to estimate the
percentage of the total page area that is out of harmony. Filter down to
candidates with less than 10% total error, and eliminate redundant candidates
favoring the layout with the least error. Finally, filter out layouts with
extreme margins.


``` r
layout_candidates <- margin_candidates |>
  mutate(

    # page area over two-page spread
    page_area_expected = 2 * mean(c(
      page_width^2 * page_ratio,
      page_height^2 / page_ratio
    )),
    page_area_actual = 2 * page_width * page_height,

    page_2up_area_expected = mean(c(
      (2 * page_width)^2 * page_2up_ratio,
      page_height^2 / page_2up_ratio
    )),
    page_2up_area_actual = 2 * page_width * page_height,

    # text area over two-page spread
    text_2up_area_expected = mean(c(
      (2 * (text_width + i_mar))^2 * text_2up_ratio,
      text_height^2 / text_2up_ratio
    )),
    text_2up_area_actual = 2 * (text_width + i_mar) * text_height,

    # margin rectangles over two-page spread
    ot_area_expected = 2 * mean(c(o_mar^2 / ot_ratio, t_mar^2 * ot_ratio)),
    ot_area_actual = 2 * o_mar * t_mar,
    ob_area_expected = 2 * mean(c(o_mar^2 / ob_ratio, b_mar^2 * ob_ratio)),
    ob_area_actual = 2 * o_mar * b_mar,
    ti_area_expected = 2 * mean(c(t_mar^2 / ti_ratio, i_mar^2 * ti_ratio)),
    ti_area_actual = 2 * t_mar * i_mar,
    bi_area_expected = 2 * mean(c(b_mar^2 / bi_ratio, i_mar^2 * bi_ratio)),
    bi_area_actual = 2 * b_mar * i_mar,
    tii_area_expected = mean(c(t_mar^2 / tii_ratio, (2 * i_mar)^2 * tii_ratio)),
    tii_area_actual = t_mar * (2 * i_mar),
    bii_area_expected = mean(c(b_mar^2 / bii_ratio, (2 * i_mar)^2 * bii_ratio)),
    bii_area_actual = b_mar * (2 * i_mar)
  ) |>
  mutate( # account for overlap
    across(matches("^page_(2up_)?area"), ~ . / 2),
    across(matches("^[tb]ii?_area"), ~ . / 2)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(matches("expected|actual$")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(name, "_area_", names = c("area_name", "name")) |>
  pivot_wider() |>
  mutate(error = abs(actual - expected)) |>
  summarise(.by = names(margin_candidates), error = sum(error)) |>
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("ratio"), function(x) {
      y <- x
      if (is.numeric(x)) y <- name_ratios(x)
      factor(y, levels = names(sort(ratios)))
    }),
    text_pct = (text_width * text_height) / (page_width * page_height),
    error = error / (2 * page_width * page_height) # as percentage of 2-up area
  ) |>
  slice_min(
    n = 1,
    by = c("text_width", "text_height", "page_ratio"),
    order_by = error
  ) |>
  filter(
    error < 0.1,
    between(72.27 * b_mar / 12, 3, 6),
    between(72.27 * t_mar / 12, 2, 5),
    between(72.27 * o_mar / 12, 2, 6),
    between(72.27 * i_mar / 12, 2, 5),
    ratios[as.character(ob_ratio)] <= 1
  ) |>
  arrange(text_ratio, page_ratio, text_pct) |>
  mutate(layout_id = row_number(), across(where(is.factor), droplevels)) |>
  relocate(layout_id) |>
  relocate(error, .after = everything())
```
